summary: The data is fixed and correct now, but the classic game is too easy: name the big western states and you clear it without losing a life. It works better as a Blitz, where every state scores and the big ones are worth more.
reasons: Casual: 10/10 in 10 guesses with no lives lost (Alaska, Texas, California, then the West). Fan: 10/10, only Utah (#13) cost a life. Nothing on the board surprises, apart from Michigan at #11.
Top 10 is right (Nevada #7, Idaho #14, total area including water), and postal codes match for all 10.
Blitz: a casual player names 35 states in 90 seconds and all of them score.
fixes: us-states-area: territories and DC are ranked among the states (Puerto Rico #49, Northern Mariana Islands #51, DC #56) though the prompt says states. Keep them as free answers without a rank so state ranks run 1-50.
